I sent Pree the list in our DM. I first checked that they're a member of #central-team, then read the whole channel. Only three Marrow Agrisupply sites come up:

- **Eastbank:** Hollis posted this on 9 Jun 2026. Ticket PD-4821 has the door import attached, but the import labels doors E1/E2 while their booking sheet uses 01/02. That needs sorting before anyone reimports, or there will be duplicates.
- **Pine Crossing:** Pree posted this on 9 Jun 2026. The store's appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift, so the morning receiver can't book early arrivals.
- **Wichita store:** Pree mentioned it on 2 Jul 2025. This one is a guess: the message doesn't name Marrow. It just follows a mention of the Marrow Agrisupply office hours, so I asked Pree to confirm it.

I also told Pree what I left out:
- The Tulsa hub in the channel belongs to Tansley Parcel, a different customer.
- On 9 Jun, three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker just said "waiting." The channel never says which stores those are, so the full list is probably in the tracker or what store ops sent.

There's nothing in my reply that needs approval: no money terms, no outside mail, and nothing from other channels or DMs.
